description: Given the root of a binary tree, calculate the vertical order traversal. For each column (left to right), report nodes from top to bottom. Nodes in the same row and column are sorted by value.
intuition: Assign (column, row) coordinates to each node during DFS. Sorting all nodes by column, then row, then value gives you the vertical order traversal. Grouping by column produces the final result.
approach: DFS to collect (col, row, val) for each node. Sort by column, then row, then value. Group by column to build the result.
explanation:
1. DFS collects (column, row, value) for each node.
2. Sort by column first, then row, then value.
3. Group nodes by column into the result.
4. Within the same column and row, nodes are sorted by value.
5. Return the grouped result.
hints: Assign (column, row) coordinates to each node.
Sort by column, then row, then value.
